title: Better Pale Garden Lite
description: Adds tiny features to make the Pale Garden better
body:
# Better Pale Garden Lite 🌲 **⚠MAKE SURE TO ENABLE THE RESOURCE PACK OR IT WON'T WORK⚠** Changes some stuff about the Pale Garden to make it slightly better ## ⚙ Changes ➕ Ambient Particles
➕ New Structure (Creaking Core)
_Found in most Pale Garden biomes, spotted by the tree with roots coming out_
➕ New Music (By James Primate)
_ELSE VI now occasionally plays_
➕ Very Minor Color Changes
➕ Mob Spawn Changes (Only Skeletons, Spiders and Endermen can spawn with Skeleton Horses as an addition)
